data.one_liner: Custom lints, quick fixes, and assists for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Pyramid Lint extends the Dart analyzer with optional rules for general Dart code and Flutter widgets. It provides opt-in lints, automated quick fixes, and refactoring assists configured through analysis_options.yaml.
use_when: You want custom lint rules and quick fixes for Dart and Flutter projects
You want to enforce coding standards via analyzer plugins
avoid_when: You do not use static analysis plugins in your workflow
strengths: Extends the Dart analyzer with opt-in rules and quick fixes
Configured directly in analysis_options.yaml as a native analyzer plugin
weaknesses: All rules are disabled by default requiring manual configuration
Breaking changes can occur when migrating across major versions
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin under the root analysis_options.yaml file under the plugins section.
